description: Optional six-host same-host HTTP to HTTPS URL redirects, adapted from a fixed upstream Redirect source.

modifications.author: NetAtlas contributors
modifications.selection: Upstream lines 13–18 narrowed to the exact original destination hosts; captures added to preserve the full path and query.
modifications.excluded: The aicoin rule changes host; other upstream redirects, region modifications, HTTP downgrades and MITM settings are excluded.

shadowrocket.installation: Manually merge the [URL Rewrite] lines into an existing profile; no standalone module import or public vendor contract is claimed.

stash.merge: Stash override dictionaries merge recursively and URL rewrite arrays prepend by default; this file does not use replace directives.

unsupportedClients.mihomo: No HTTP URL rewriting capability is claimed.
unsupportedClients.singBox: No HTTP URL rewriting capability is claimed.

validation.unit: Parses all six serialized native resource formats; checks positive and negative URL examples, same-host/path/query preservation, no HTTPS loops, no lookalikes/ports/userinfo/raw whitespace.
validation.hostContract: Reviewed against the listed official documentation; Shadowrocket remains a manual merge fragment.

httpsOriginProbe.method: curl HEAD without insecure flag or following redirects; no response body saved
httpsOriginProbe.scope: Confirms HTTPS is reachable from this environment, not every path or native interception behavior.

limitations: Only HTTP URLs reaching the client HTTP engine are eligible; this is not HSTS.
Only exact listed hosts with a leading slash and without explicit port/userinfo are matched.
302 may change a non-GET method when followed; method/body preservation is not promised.
Later site-controlled redirects and app pinning are outside this package.
